evidence.role: Screens destinations against address(this), core protocol addresses, and registered factory clones via canonicalFactory.isRaffle(destination) when destination.code.length != 0.
Rejects sponsor, protocolTreasury, and sponsorRecipient during initialize if they match address(this) or an already-registered raffle clone.
Rejects minting or transferring ERC-721 raffle tickets to address(this) or any currently registered raffle clone.
Re-screens the recipient at quoteToken payout time across redeemWinningTicket, refundTickets, releaseSponsorProceeds, and releaseProtocolFees against canonicalFactory.isRaffle(to).
Rejects already-registered raffle clones as prizeToken or sponsorRecipient at raffle creation time and requires prizeToken to have deployed bytecode.
Permissionlessly transfers the escrowed prizeToken NFT to sponsorRecipient via unsafe transferFrom without re-checking _isProtocolDestination(recipient, address(prizeToken)) at release time.

structured_output.reasoning: All four checks hold whenever destination is already a registered clone (isRaffle[destination] == true) at the time the address is configured or used: RaffleFactory._validateCreateParams (RaffleFactory.sol:L157-L169) and Raffle.initialize (Raffle.sol:L187-L195) reject existing clones for prizeToken, sponsor, protocolTreasury, and sponsorRecipient; Raffle._update (Raffle.sol:L497-L502) rejects ticket mints and transfers to registered clones; and Raffle._transferQuote (Raffle.sol:L564-L567) rejects quoteToken payouts to registered clones at transfer time. However, because RaffleFactory.createRaffle deploys clones with Clones.clone(raffleImplementation) (RaffleFactory.sol:L106, using CREATE with the factory address and sequential nonce), a future clone's address is deterministic and has code.length == 0 and isRaffle == false before deployment. If Raffle A is initialized with sponsorRecipient set to the predicted CREATE address of a subsequent Raffle B, and Raffle B is then created (setting isRaffle[raffleB] = true), releaseSponsorProceeds() blocks quoteToken transfers to Raffle B via _transferQuote's runtime _isProtocolDestination check, whereas releaseSponsorPrize() (Raffle.sol:L395-L407) omits _isProtocolDestination(recipient, address(prizeToken)) and calls prizeToken.transferFrom(address(this), recipient, prizeTokenId) directly, moving the escrowed prizeToken NFT from Raffle A into registered clone Raffle B.
